verdict.rationale: incident.io's first-party docs describe webhooks for receiving notifications when certain events occur. The docs name use cases such as annotating monitoring graphs, tracking follow-ups, and syncing on-call data like alerts, escalations and schedule changes to external tools. This clearly delivers the core ability to subscribe to events. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog and payload schemas, details on signature verification and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
